title: ScalePRM: Training Process Reward Models by Scaling Verification Compute Without Ground Truth
abstract: arXiv:2512.03244v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training process reward models (PRMs) requires step-level correctness labels, obtained either through expensive human annotation or by relying on ground-truth answers, limiting the ability to scale process-level supervision. We propose ScalePRM, which scales verification compute as an alternative: given a problem and a candidate solution, we generate multiple independent verifications of each reasoning step and aggregate their judgments to produce synthetic step-level labels without ground truth. We explore two representative inference-time scaling strategies, parallel scaling through self-consistency and sequential scaling through meta-critique, and train generative PRMs on the resulting synthetic data. On ProcessBench, a benchmark for identifying erroneous steps in mathematical reasoning, PRMs trained on step-level self-consistency data achieve 67.5 F1, surpassing reference-guided training with ground-truth access (66.4 F1) a

translated_title: ScalePRM：通过扩展验证计算在无需标准答案的情况下训练过程奖励模型
translated_abstract: 训练过程奖励模型（PRMs）需要步骤级别的正确性标签，这些标签通常通过昂贵的人工标注获得，或依赖于标准答案，这限制了过程级监督的扩展能力。我们提出ScalePRM，将扩展验证计算作为一种替代方案：给定一个问题和候选解答，我们对每个推理步骤生成多个独立的验证，并聚合这些判断结果，从而在无需标准答案的情况下生成合成的步骤级标签。我们探索了两种代表性的推理时扩展策略——通过自一致性进行并行扩展和通过元批评进行顺序扩展，并使用所得的合成数据训练生成式过程奖励模型。在ProcessBench（一个用于识别数学推理中错误步骤的基准测试）上，使用步骤级自一致性数据训练的过程奖励模型达到了67.5 F1，超越了使用标准答案的参考引导训练方法（66.4 F1）。
tldr: ScalePRM通过对每个推理步骤生成多次独立验证并聚合判断结果，在无需标准答案或人工标注的情况下生成合成步骤级标签来训练过程奖励模型，其性能甚至超越了使用标准答案的训练方法。
en_tdlr: ScalePRM trains process reward models by generating multiple independent verifications of each reasoning step and aggregating judgments into synthetic step-level labels without ground truth, surpassing even training methods that rely on ground-truth answers.
